camel_example: aliyun r-kvstore ModifyDBInstanceConnectionString --region cn-hangzhou --IPType Public --CurrentConnectionString 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000.redis.rds.aliyuncs.com' --DBInstanceId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --Port 6379 --NewConnectionString standardredis123
description_en: Changes the endpoint or port number of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
description_zh: 修改云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的连接地址和端口
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore modify-db-instance-connection-string --db-instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --new-connection-string standardredis123 --current-connection-string r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000.redis.rds.aliyuncs.com --port 6379 --ip-type Public --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstanceConnectionString

parameters.description_en:
The prefix of the new endpoint. Specify the endpoint in the `<prefix>.redis.rds.aliyuncs.com` format. The prefix must be 8 to 40 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters and digits. It must start with a lowercase letter.

>  You must specify one of the **NewConnectionString** and **Port** parameters.
parameters.description_zh:
新连接地址的前缀。实例的连接地址格式为：`<前缀>.redis.rds.aliyuncs.com`。地址前缀需由小写英文字母、数字组成，但必须以小写字母开头，长度为8~40个字符。
> 请求参数**NewConnectionString**和**Port**两者中必须传入一项。
